reopened.purpose: Original posting/SKU fee precedence; same-period expenses; monetary N denominator
Saved source schemas and type grouping; not blindly imported collector code
Aggregate posting endpoint contains amount/date/sku/quantity but no stable accrual_id in shown rows; cannot manufacture identity
Five actual archived selected-component rows for arithmetic replay; fee origin still ambiguous previous-debit-or-tariff

normalization_requirements.fees: Stable source-derived atomic event identity and full coverage; declared original/correction/sale-reversal, parent reference, original signed amount/currency. No ID made from a rounded amount.
normalization_requirements.fee_quantity: Partial/overlapping original debit coverage is rejected until decomposed with proof; not blindly added to full tariff.
normalization_requirements.fee_period: The period in the normalized contract identifies the ORDER cohort, not a restriction to accruals only on those days. Late same-cohort fees are allowed.
normalization_requirements.source_verifier: Trusted existing-job ledger callback must verify provider receipt, complete pagination/coverage, source state, timestamps and same tenant/store; complete=true alone never qualifies.
normalization_requirements.tariffs: SameSKU/scheme own quote; explicit units; quote time retained through source receipt, not silently historical actual.
normalization_requirements.storage_advertising: Explicit full-period source amounts. This allocation is not per-order actual. Absent data does not mean zero.
normalization_requirements.posting_allocation: Only explicitly declared other costs (currently type93) may be allocated by original physical units; marked QUALIFIED_POSTING_ALLOCATION. Commission/acquiring/processing require item attribution, not inferred original debits.
normalization_requirements.corrections: All parent edges validated before cohort filtering and aggregation. A child pointing outside its parent posting/SKU/scheme/type/currency/quantity cannot affect the selected cohort or be ignored as foreign.

next_runtime_work: Wire normalization/receipts and current owner proof into the existing compound Query/Worker, then final-model basis/fence; no second queue or direct arbitrary HTTP.
